newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: United Paragon says Jan-Mar gold output up.
newsitem.headline: United Paragon says Jan-Mar gold output up.

text.p: United Paragon Mining Corp said on Friday its gold output for the first quarter of 1997 rose by 29 percent to 11,370 ounces from 8,801 ounces in the same period last year.

United Paragon vice-president Pedro Oyam said in a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange that United's total gold shipment during the period was 47 percent higher at 11,802 ounces from 8,010 ounces a year-ago.
Oyam attributed the higher output to an increase in the tonnage of ore milled, better grade and higher recovery.
He added that four companies had expressed interest in United's Malaguit project in Camarines Norte province in the central Philippines.

The firms, which are conducting due diligence work, are Placer Pacific Exploration Philippines Inc, a unit of Placer Dome Inc; CRA/Tropical Exploration Phils Inc; International Pursuit Phils Inc; and Mineralindo Rejeki Alam (MRA) of Indonesia.
